task_completion.description: Open the unformatted document and the style guide
task_completion.visual_evidence: LibreOffice Writer (or similar) showing 'ashen_king_module.odt' and a text editor showing 'module_style_guide.txt' are visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: Apply the title formatting to 'The Crypt of the Ashen King'
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main title text is visually distinct (larger font/centered) compared to the body text as per style guide instructions.

task_completion.description: Apply H1 and H2 styles to the chapters and area descriptions
task_completion.visual_evidence: Headings like 'Introduction' and 'The Crypt' (H1) and 'Area 1: The Obsidian Doors' (H2) have consistent, hierarchical styling applied.
Blocks of text intended for players are visually set apart (e.g., italicized, indented, or in a box) as specified in the style guide.

task_completion.description: Format the creature stat blocks (Ashen Cultist, Bone Golem, Ashen King)
task_completion.visual_evidence: The creature statistics are formatted into distinct blocks with H3 headers for the names, following the specific layout in the style guide.

task_completion.description: Save the changes to the document
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon is clicked, or the 'Modified' status in the window title bar disappears, indicating the file has been saved.

integrity.description: The agent used the word processor GUI rather than command-line manipulation
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with LibreOffice menus, toolbars, or style dropdowns.

integrity.description: The agent did not delete the module content to simplify formatting
integrity.visual_evidence: The document still contains the full text of the adventure, including the areas and stat blocks, after formatting.

integrity.description: The agent applied styles rather than just changing font size manually
integrity.visual_evidence: The style inspector or style sidebar in the word processor shows specific style names (e.g., 'Heading 1') being applied.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The document 'ashen_king_module.odt' must be formatted according to 'module_style_guide.txt'. Key content includes: Title: 'The Crypt of the Ashen King'; H1 Chapters: 'Introduction', 'The Crypt'; H2 Areas: 'Area 1: The Obsidian Doors', 'Area 2: The Hall of Whispers', 'Area 3: The Throne Room'; H3 Stat Blocks: 'Ashen Cultist', 'Bone Golem', 'The Ashen King'. The agent must use the GUI to apply these styles and save the file.
